from.name: Linux TCP_INFO / struct tcp_info observability ABI

property: The TCP_INFO observability ABI gains delivery-rate and application-limited indicators derived from newer ACK/rate-sampling machinery while retaining older RTT, cwnd, retransmission and path fields.

date_or_range.notes: Delivery-rate export arrives alongside the BBR-era rate-sampling work.

negative_claims: The exported delivery-rate field is generic TCP telemetry and is not synonymous with BBR.
This interface extension does not imply older fields were deprecated.
open_questions: Build a release-indexed complete struct tcp_info field genealogy.
